- New `@DoxEnv()` and `@EnvKey('X')` for the typed env class.

### 3.0.0-alpha.1

- Version 3 of Dox. All Dox packages now share one version.
- Needs Dart 3.6 or newer.
- See the [release notes](https://github.com/dartondox/dox/pull/112) for all main changes.

## dox_builder

### 3.2.1

- New: a default that reads the global `env` (like `env.appEnv`) stopped the app with a stack overflow. Now `load()` throws a clear `StateError` that says to use the getter directly.
- Fix: a run of capitals in an env getter name is one word now. `dbURL` read `DB_U_R_L`, now it reads `DB_URL`. Also `jwtTTL` => `JWT_TTL` and `httpURLPath` => `HTTP_URL_PATH`. Names like `s3Bucket` and `oauth2ClientId` do not change. If your `.env` has a key like `DB_U_R_L`, rename it, or use `@EnvKey('DB_U_R_L')`.
- Fix: `@EnvKey` through a const variable (`const k = EnvKey('X');` then `@k`) was ignored. Now it is read.
- Fix: an env getter named `r` or `reader` made `env.g.dart` fail to compile. The generated `load()` now uses `$r` and `$reader`.
- Fix: an instance field in a `@DoxEnv()` class was not read from the env, with no warning. Now it is a build error that says to use a getter.
- Fix: in a `@DoxEnv()` class, a getter body that uses another getter saw the default of that getter, not the loaded value. So `String get appUrl => 'http://localhost:$appPort';` gave port 3000 even with `APP_PORT=4000`. Now a getter body runs on the loaded env and sees the real values. A key that is set still wins over the body. A default that throws still stops the app in `load()`. Run `dart run build_runner build` to get the new `env.g.dart`.

### 3.2.0

- New: the job builder moved here from dox_queue. It writes `lib/generated/jobs.g.dart` with every `@Job()` class, the same file as before. It runs only in an app that has dox_queue in `dependencies` or `dev_dependencies`. (When the build can not read the app's `pubspec.yaml`, it runs when the app can import dox_queue.) If your `build.yaml` names the builder `dox_queue:jobs`, change it to `dox_builder:jobs`.
- Breaking: this dox_builder needs dox_queue 3.2 or newer. With dox_queue 3.1, both packages have a builder for `jobs.g.dart`, and `build_runner` stops at start with "outputs collide". Run `dart pub upgrade` to move both together. An app that must stay on dox_queue 3.1 turns off the new builder, and the dox_queue 3.1 builder keeps making the file:
  ```yaml
  # build.yaml of the app
  targets:
    $default:
      builders:
        dox_builder:jobs:
          enabled: false
  ```
- New: when the app can import dox_mailer, `jobs.g.dart` also lists the mail jobs of `Mail.queue()` (`SendQueuedMail` and `SendEncryptedQueuedMail`). So the worker can read them before `Mail.configure()` runs. The saved job names do not change. A dox_mailer without these classes (3.1) gets no mail lines.
- Finds `DoxProvider` classes from `dox_annotation`. Release it together with `dox_annotation` and `dox_core`. An app must upgrade dox_builder together with dox_core, or its providers are not found.
- New: the OpenAPI schema of a model reads `visibleFields`, like `hidden`: with a list, only its keys are in the schema. Needs the next dox_orm for `toJson()` to match.
- New: `onTrashed()` counts as a model hook, so a model with only that hook gets `hasModelHooks`. Needs the next dox_orm.
- New: models get `$copyColumnsFrom()`. It copies every column field from another model of the same class. `refresh()` in the next dox_orm uses it, so it works for columns with a cast or a `beforeGet`. Nothing else calls it, so reads and saves do no extra work.
- New: models read `@HasManyThrough` and `@HasOneThrough`. Needs the next dox_orm.
- New: DTOs read `@Dto(trim: true)`, `@Dto(coerce: true)` and `@Dto(attributes: {...})`. Needs the next dox_validation.
- New: `@After` and `@Before` take `'today'`, `'tomorrow'`, `'yesterday'` and the input key of another `DateTime` field. New `@AfterOrEqual` and `@BeforeOrEqual`. A text that is not a date, a word or a `DateTime` field stops the build. The words and fields work with any dox_validation. `@AfterOrEqual` and `@BeforeOrEqual` need the next dox_validation.
- New: DTOs read `@RequiredUnless`, `@RequiredWithout`, `@RequiredWithoutAll`, `@Filled`, `@Present`, `@Prohibited`, `@ProhibitedIf`, `@ExcludeIf` and `@ExcludeUnless`. Each one on an always-required field stops the build, like `@RequiredIf`. Needs the next dox_validation.
- New: the rules `@Different` and the field compare rules check the whole field on a `List` field, not each item. Rules that name another key stop the build when they name a Dart field name in place of the input key.
- A DTO that uses none of these gets the same code as before.
- OpenAPI: a controller method that calls `req.authorize(...)` gets a `401` and a `403` answer in the docs. A `@Response` with the same status wins.
- OpenAPI: a controller method that calls `req.validateSchema(...)`, or `req.validate<T>()` with no request class found, gets a `422` answer. A `@Response(422, ...)` wins. Needs the next dox_core.
- OpenAPI: a controller method that calls `Gate.authorize(...)` gets a `403` answer in the docs. A `@Response(403, ...)` wins.
- DTOs: a DTO with no `@RequiredIf` or `@RequiredWith` field (and no nested DTO with one) now writes `usesRequiredWhen => false`. Then the check does not keep each converted value, which saves work. Needs the next dox_validation.
- New: DTO code reads the DTO flags of `ValidationFlags` at run time: `dtoAllErrors`, `dtoRejectEmptyList` and `dtoMaybeRejectsEmpty`. All are off by default, so the checks work as before. The builder writes this code only when the app's dox_validation has `DtoState.allErrors`. With an older dox_validation it writes the old code, so it still compiles.
- New: a model `@BelongsTo` field passes its name as `relation:` to `belongsTo()`, for the dox_orm flag `belongsToKeyFromRelation`. The builder writes it only when the app's dox_orm has the `relation:` parameter. With an older dox_orm the code does not change.
- Fix: `@OrDefault()` on a `Maybe<T>` field no longer stops the build. A bad value gives `Maybe.missing()`.
- Fix: a nested DTO deeper in lists and maps, like `List<List<A>>` or `Map<String, List<A>>`, now runs its `validate()` and its async rules. Before, only one level (`List<A>`, `Map<String, A>`) was found. So after `build_runner`, an app may now get errors from these deeper DTOs that were skipped before.

### 3.1.3

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.1.2

- DTOs: `@Describe('...')` on a field sets `description` in its JSON Schema (the generated `toJsonSchema()` and the OpenAPI docs). It wins over the `///` doc comment. Needs dox_validation 3.1.2.

### 3.1.1

- DTOs: `@Dto(emptyStringsToNull: true)` makes the generated code read `""` as `null` (needs the next dox_validation).
- DTOs: `@OrDefault()` makes a bad value of that field give its default (or `null`) instead of an error. A field with `@OrDefault()` and no default that is not nullable stops the build.

### 3.1.0

- Fix: the JSON Schema pattern of `@AlphaDash` now allows digits, like the check does (needs dox_validation 3.1.0). The OpenAPI output of a DTO with `@AlphaDash` changes.
- Fix: in generated DTO code, `@RequiredIf` and `@RequiredWith` now run after all fields are converted. Before, a rule on a field read the raw value of a field that comes after it, like `' PRO '`, not `'pro'` after `@Trim` and `@Lowercase`. Run `build_runner` to get the new code.
- Fix: `reload()` and preload now set a nullable `@HasOne`, `@BelongsTo`, `@MorphOne` or `@MorphTo` field to null when the related row is gone. Before, the field kept its old value. Run `build_runner` to get the new code.
- Fix: `reload()` and preload now set a `@HasMany`, `@ManyToMany` or `@MorphMany` field to an empty list when there are no related rows. Before, the field kept its old list. Run `build_runner` to get the new code.
- Behavior change: a nullable list relation, like `List<Tag>? tags`, is now `[]` (not `null`) after a preload with no rows.
- DTOs: `@RequiredIf('type', 'company')` and `@RequiredWith(['phone'])` from `dox_validation`. The field is required only when the condition is true. Use them on a nullable field, a `Maybe` field or a field with a default. On an always-required field the build stops with a clear error.
- DTOs: the build stops when `@RequiredIf`, `@RequiredWith`, `@Same` or `@Confirmed(other:)` names a Dart field (like `accountType`) instead of its input key (`account_type`). The check would never match. It also stops for a `@DateFormatted` format with a letter it does not know.
- DTOs: in a `@Dto(strict: true)` class, the key that `@Confirmed` reads (like `password_confirmation`) is not an unknown key.
- New: DTO file rules `@MinSize('10KB')`, `@MimeTypes(['image/png', 'image/*'])` and `@Dimensions(minWidth:, maxWidth:, minHeight:, maxHeight:, width:, height:, ratio:)`. They need dox_validation 3.1.0 or newer. A bad size or a `@Dimensions()` with no limit stops the build.
- New: `@ManyToMany(withPivot: [...], withTimestamps: true)` is passed to the ORM, so the relation reads the extra pivot columns. Needs dox_orm 3.1.0 or newer.
- New: the model builder makes the code for `@MorphMany`, `@MorphOne` and `@MorphTo` (polymorphic relations). A `@MorphTo` field has no model: its type is the field type, like `Model<dynamic>`, and its morph name is the field name in snake_case. The OpenAPI model schema has these relation keys too. Needs dox_orm 3.1.0 or newer.

### 3.0.2

- **Breaking: column and JSON keys can change.** Please read this before you update.
  - Digits are no longer split off. Before, `address2` gave the key `address_2`. Now it gives `address2`.
  - A name you give is used exactly as written. Before, `@Column(name: 'userID')` gave `user_i_d`. Now it gives `userID`. The same is true for `@Computed(name:)`, and for `primaryKey`, `createdAt` and `updatedAt` in `@DoxModel`.
  - DTO input keys change the same way: a field `line2` now reads the key `line2`, not `line_2`.
  - What to do: run `build_runner` and look for changed keys in the generated files. Then rename the column in a migration. Or keep the old key with `@Column(name: 'address_2')` (or `@Name('line_2')` on a DTO field).
- Fix: types from an import with a prefix (`import 'other.dart' as o;`) keep the prefix in the generated code, like `o.Role`, `List<o.Role>`, `EnumCast(o.Role.values)` and `o.$InnerDto`. Before, the code did not compile. This works in models, DTOs, env classes and scopes.
- Fix: `@Column(cast: ...)` now works for a model in a `part` file. The cast is read from the AST of the field.
- Fix: table names, column keys and relation keys are escaped in the generated code (`\`, `'` and `$`).
- Fix: a private class (like `_AdminRouter` or `@Inject() class _Cache`) is no longer put in `container.g.dart`, where it did not compile. The build shows a warning with the class and file.
- Fix: container errors now show the file and line of the problem.
- New: a constructor parameter of an abstract type gets the one container class that implements it. When two or more classes implement it, the build stops and names them.
- Fix: the OpenAPI builder reads the files in path order, so `openapi.g.dart` does not change between builds.
- Fix: the OpenAPI builder finds routes with a prefixed dox_core import, like `dox.Route.get(...)`. Only the `Route` class of dox_core counts.
- Fix: the OpenAPI builder stops with a clear error when two controllers, two `@Security` classes or two schema classes have the same name in two files. Before, one silently replaced the other. Dox finds them by name at runtime, so a new name would not match. Rename one of them.
- Fix: OpenAPI annotations count only when they come from a Dox package (`package:dox_...`). An app class with the same name, like `Summary`, is no longer read as one.
- Faster builds: the container, DTO list and OpenAPI builders skip `.g.dart` files. They also look at the text of a file first, and only resolve it when it can hold what they look for.
- Change: the model, DTO and env builder runs on `lib/` only by default. Before, it also ran on `test/`, `bin/` and `tool/`. A package with models or DTOs in `test/` adds this to its `build.yaml`:

    ```yaml
    targets:
      $default:
        builders:
          dox_builder:
            generate_for: ["lib/**", "test/**"]
    ```

### 3.0.1

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0

- The first stable release.

### 3.0.0-rc.1

- `lib/generated/dtos.g.dart` is now written for every app, also with no `@Dto`. The list is empty then. So the app can always have `dtos: dtos` in `AppConfig`. An app here is a package that imports `AppConfig` (from dox_core). Other packages with no DTO still get no file. The empty list is `final`, not `const`, so `dtos: dtos` does not trigger the `avoid_redundant_argument_values` lint.

### 3.0.0-alpha.17

- New: models get `setColumnValue(column, value)`. It sets a field by its column name, and returns false when the value is not of the field type. `model.increment()` and `model.decrement()` of dox_orm use it to set the field. The generated code needs the dox_orm that has `Model.setColumnValue()`. Run build_runner again after you update.

### 3.0.0-alpha.16

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.15

- Change: the container builder finds every class that extends `DoxProvider` and writes `c.provider<...>` for it.

### 3.0.0-alpha.14

- New: the openapi builder reads `@Security` on middleware classes and writes them to `OpenApiRegistry.security`.

### 3.0.0-alpha.13

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.12

- Fix: a route inside `Route.group('/web-auth', registerWebAuth)` lost the group prefix when the callback was a method or function, not a closure. The builder now reads that method with the prefix, also for nested groups. The route call in `openapi.g.dart` now has the full path, like `/web-auth/login`.

### 3.0.0-alpha.11

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.10

- The app-wide files are now written to `lib/generated/`: `lib/generated/container.g.dart`, `lib/generated/dtos.g.dart` and `lib/generated/openapi.g.dart`. This keeps them out of the top of `lib/`. Import them from `package:<app>/generated/...`. Delete the old files in `lib/` after you run `dart run build_runner build`.
- Model part files (like `user.model.g.dart`) still sit next to their source file.

### 3.0.0-alpha.9

- New: `lib/container.g.dart` builder. It finds every `@Inject()` class, every class that extends `Router`, every class that implements `DoxService` and every `@DoxModel` in `lib/`. It writes `registerContainer(IocContainer c)`, which makes each class with its constructor. Constructor parameters come from the container by type. Optional parameters that the container can not give keep their default. Required nullable ones get `null`.
- The build stops with a clear message for a required parameter the container can not give, for a dependency cycle (it shows the chain, like `A -> B -> A`), and for an abstract or generic `@Inject()` class. Two classes with the same name work: every import has a prefix.
- OpenAPI: typed routes (`Route.get<C>(path, (C c) => c.method)`) and `Route.resource(path, ControllerClass)` are read too.
- Generates the query scopes: an extension with one method for each `@Scope()` method, and `globalScopes` for `@Scope(global: true)`.
- Generates the column casts: `fromMap()` and `columnsToMap()` use the `cast` of `@Column()`. `bool` and enum fields get a cast without `cast`.
- Run `dart run build_runner build` to get the new code.

### 3.0.0-alpha.8

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.7

- The generated `fromMap()` takes a `DateTime` from the driver as it is. It only parses a string.
- New generated `columnsToMap()` with the columns only. `convertToMap()` adds the relations to it.
- Models with no `beforeGet` hook get `readsRowDates => true`, so their rows skip the date to string step. A `beforeGet` hook still gets dates as strings.
- `tableColumns`, `preloadList`, `timestampsColumn` and the relation matchers are `const`, so no new list or map is made on each call.
- Run `dart run build_runner build` to get the new code.

### 3.0.0-alpha.6

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.5

- `@DoxModel(timestamps: false)` makes a model without `createdAt` and `updatedAt`. `createdAt: null` or `updatedAt: null` turns off only one.
- The primary key field has the type of `@DoxModel(primaryKeyType: ...)`. It was always `int?`. The default is still `int`. The OpenAPI model schema uses the same type.
- Fix: a preloaded relation with a two word name (like `userInfo`) was missing from `toJson()`. The generator looked for `user_info` in the preload list, but the list has `userInfo`.
- Fix: the OpenAPI route scanner now puts one `/` between a group and a route path, like the router does.

### 3.0.0-alpha.4

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.3

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.2

- Needs Dart 3.13 or newer.
- All dependencies updated to their latest versions.
- New builder `dox_builder:openapi`. It writes `lib/openapi.g.dart` with the OpenAPI docs of the app: it reads the `Route.*` calls, the controllers, the `@Dto` classes and the models. It writes nothing when the package has no controllers.
- `DtoJsonSchema`, `ModelSchema` and `JsonSchemaReader`: the JSON Schema of a `@Dto` class, a model or any Dart type. Other builders can use them.
- New: the DTO generator. For each `@Dto` class it writes `$<Name>Dto` (a `const DtoSchema<Name>`) into the `.g.dart` part: plain `if` checks per field, the converter, `fromMap`, `toMap` and the JSON Schema. It stops the build with a clear error for a bad DTO (a field that is not final, a type that is not supported, a rule that does not fit, a bad regex, ...).
- New builder `dox_builder:dtos`. It writes `lib/dtos.g.dart` with every DTO of the app, for `AppConfig(dtos: dtos)`. Two DTOs with the same name stop the build.
- `DtoReader`: the one place that knows DTO keys. The OpenAPI docs use the same keys as the DTO (snake_case by default, `@Name`, `@Dto(keyCase:)`).
- OpenAPI: `@Regex` (was `@Pattern`). `@Format` is removed. Form requests are removed.
- Fix: the OpenAPI route list has the full path, with the `Router` prefix and `Route.group()` prefixes. Two `'/'` routes in two groups now each get their docs.
- OpenAPI path params: every positional argument that is not the request and not a DTO.
- New: `@DoxEnv()` classes get `_$<Class>` in the `.g.dart` part. Each getter is read from the env once, converted to its type (String, int, double, num, bool, Uri, Duration, enum, List<String>) and kept in a final field. A getter body is the default. A nullable getter is optional. `load()` throws one `EnvException` with every missing or bad key.

- Version 3 of Dox. All Dox packages now share one version.
- Needs Dart 3.6 or newer.
- See the [release notes](https://github.com/dartondox/dox/pull/112) for all main changes.
- Works with analyzer 5 and 6.

## dox_cache

### 3.2.0

- New: `dox cache:install [--store=file|redis|memory|database]`, run by `dox add cache`. It writes `lib/config/cache.dart`, the `CACHE_STORE` key and the `AppEnv` getters, and adds `cache: cache` to `lib/config/app.dart`. With `--store=database` it also adds `dox_cache_database`, its provider and the cache table migration. It never overwrites a file. dox_cache now depends on dox_annotation.
- New: `'encrypt': true` on a `file` or `redis` store encrypts the values. It is off by default, so nothing changes for stores without it. Set `CacheConfig(encrypter: ...)` with a `CacheEncrypter`. A store with `'encrypt': true` and no encrypter throws a `StateError`, for every store type. Memory and null stores do not encrypt. An `encrypt` value that is not `true` or `false` throws an `ArgumentError`.
- On Redis, a plain `int` stays plain text when encryption is on, so `increment` and `decrement` still work. Every other value is encrypted. To keep a secret number encrypted, store it as a `String`.
- A value that cannot be decrypted (wrong key, changed text) reads as a miss. An old plain value reads as a miss too, except an `int` on Redis.
- `FileDriver.prune()` deletes files that cannot be decrypted when encryption is on.
- Cache keys and tag names are not encrypted, and a value is not tied to its key. Encryption protects against reading only. `maxValueBytes` is checked on the plain JSON size.
- Ships an AI agent skill (dox-cache-guide). Install it in your app with `dart run skills@ get`.
- New: `CacheFlags`, opt-in behaviors that work like Laravel, as `CacheConfig(flags: ...)`. All are off by default. `CacheFlags.all()` turns on every flag.
- New: `CacheFlags.lockThrows` makes `lock.block(timeout)` with no callback throw `LockTimeoutException` when the time is over, not give `false`.
- New: `CacheLock.throwOnTimeout` picks this for one lock. A store sets it from the flag. `CacheStore` takes `flags:`.

### 3.1.3

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.1.2

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.1.1

- New: `flexible` takes a null `stale`. Then the value is kept until a refresh replaces it, so callers still get the last good value when `compute` fails.

### 3.1.0

- New: the file driver can delete expired and broken files by itself. Set the `prune_every` option (or `FileDriver(pruneEvery: ...)`) to run `prune()` in the background once every that many writes. It is off by default (`0`). Only one prune runs at a time, and a failed prune is ignored.
- Fix: `FileDriver.prune()` could delete a new value that `add`, `increment` or `touch` wrote at the same time. Now it takes the same key lock as they do and reads the file again under it. A key that is locked right now is skipped.

### 3.0.2

- Fix: `remember` and `rememberForever` threw on a cache hit when `T` was not a raw JSON type, like `List<String>`. Pass the new `decode` option to turn the cached JSON into `T`. Without it, `T` must be a raw JSON type.
- Fix: `remember` runs `compute` once when many calls for the same key run at the same time in one isolate. The others wait for the first. With the new `lock: true`, callers in other isolates and servers wait too.
- Fix: `pull` is atomic now. Redis uses `GETDEL` (needs Redis 6.2 or newer). Drivers get a new `pull` method.
- Fix: the file driver keeps each prefix in its own sub folder. `flush` deletes only the files of its own prefix, and keeps temp files of writes that are running.
- Change: because of this, files written by older versions are in the base folder and are not found any more. It is a cache, so they are only misses. You can delete the old files in the base folder by hand.
- Fix: a file driver read no longer deletes an expired or broken file. Another isolate may have just written a new value. Use the new `FileDriver.prune()` to delete expired and broken files.
- Fix: the file driver has locks now (`File.create(exclusive: true)`). `add`, `increment` and `touch` take a lock on the key, so they are safe across isolates.
- Fix: a Redis prefix with no `:` at the end gets one. So the prefix `app` does not match the keys of `app2`.
- New: `flexible(key, fresh, stale, compute)`: stale while revalidate.
- New: `touch(key, ttl)` sets a new ttl and keeps the value.
- New: `get` and `pull` take a function as the default. It runs only on a miss.
- New: `lock.block(timeout, callback)` runs the callback while it holds the lock. It throws `LockTimeoutException` when the time is over. `lock.forceRelease()` frees a lock of any owner.
- New: the Redis option `max_value_bytes`.
- Faster: tagged `many`, `putMany`, `has`, `pull` and `remember` read the tag versions once per call.
- Faster: the memory driver keeps the expiry as int milliseconds. It does not read the clock for items with no expiry. `has` does not decode the value.
- Change: `MemoryEntry.expiresAt` is an `int` in milliseconds now. `CacheClock` has a new `nowMs()`.

### 3.0.0-alpha.7

- Perf: the memory driver removes expired items and expired locks in a sweep after many writes. Before, a key that was written once with a ttl and never read again stayed in memory forever.
- Perf: the memory driver with no `max_size` does not reorder the map on every hit. The order is only needed for LRU.
- Perf: a tagged cache reads all tag versions with one `many` call (one `MGET` on Redis). `tags(...).flush()` raises all tag versions at the same time. Before, each tag was one round trip after the other.
- Perf: the Redis driver frees a lock with `EVALSHA`. It sends the full script only when Redis does not know it yet.
- Perf: the file driver makes the cache folder only when it is missing. Before, it ran `create(recursive: true)` on every write. Lock tokens use one shared `Random.secure()`.

### 3.0.0-alpha.6

- New `CacheManager.close()`. It closes the connections of every store that was built. The Redis driver closes its connection and its pool connections, with no reconnect. Memory, file and null stores do nothing. It is safe to call twice. A store used after it is built again.
- New `CacheDriver.close()`, for one driver. Custom drivers can override it. The default does nothing.

### 3.0.0-alpha.5

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.4

- Version bump only, to match the other packages.

### 3.0.0-alpha.3

- New: `getRaw(key)` gives the stored value as JSON text, with no decode. Use it to send a cached value as a JSON response. Memory and Redis return the stored text as is. A stored String comes back with its quotes (`"bar"`). The stored format did not change, so old values still read the same.
- Faster `get`: a plain store builds the key with no async step. `itemKey` now returns `FutureOr<String>`. Memory `get` costs about 0.6 µs instead of 0.86 µs. Memory `getRaw` costs about 0.3 µs.
- New Redis option `pool_size`: the most connections one store opens (ioredis `maxConnection`). Default is 10, the same as before.
- Uses `ioredis` 2.0.0-alpha.2. It sends all commands on one shared connection and writes them together (auto-pipelining). A Redis read costs much less CPU. The cache now uses one connection per store, so `pool_size` rarely matters.
